Class ImageType

java.lang.Object
  com.pdfjet.ImageType

public class ImageType
extends java.lang.Object

Used to specify the image type of an image. Supported types: ImageType.JPG, ImageType.PNG, ImageType.BMP and ImageType.JET See the Image class for more information.
